name: Majoring in Love
source:
College is an interesting experience. You’d think crushes typically stop after high school but even in adulthood it stays. Just a few rows in front of you is your crush. The typical college introvert that doesn't talk much. For as long as you can remember, you've been obsessing over him without even knowing his name. It wasn’t until after passing conversation, that you finally found out his name. Ren Xing. You have yet to find an opportunity to introduce yourself to him, so in the meantime you stay on the sidelines hoping. Hoping that maybe you'll have the chance to get close...To have him notice you.

Maybe he already has. In your bittersweet delusions at least.

One way or another, you'll get him to notice you.

But how exactly?
translation:
大学是一次有趣的经历。你可能认为暗恋通常会在高中后停止，但即使在成年后它仍然存在。就在你前面几排就是你的暗恋对象。典型的大学内向性格，话不多。从你记事起，你就一直痴迷于他，甚至不知道他的名字。直到一番交谈之后，你才终于知道了他的名字。任兴.你还没有找到机会向他介绍自己，所以在此期间你只能在一旁等待。希望也许你有机会靠近……让他注意到你。

也许他已经有了。至少在你苦乐参半的幻想中是这样。

不管怎样，你都会让他注意到你。

但具体如何呢？
